result.title: BitDecoding-FP4: Native FP4 KV Cache Decoding via Algorithm-System Co-Design
result.summary: The key-value (KV) cache dominates memory capacity and bandwidth in long-context LLM serving. While 4-bit microscaling formats (NVFP4, MXFP4) shrink the cache and run attention on FP4 Tensor Cores, a fundamental gap remains between algorithmic quantization and system-aware acceleration: existing FP4 KV systems use vanilla quantization that causes severe accuracy drops, whereas accuracy-oriented 4-bit algorithms rely on vector codebooks whose lookup overhead degrades decoding throughput. We present BitDecoding-FP4, an algorithm--system co-design for accurate and efficient native FP4 KV decoding. We mitigate three error sources: Dual-Residual Query Quantization splits queries into two FP4 tensors, cutting query logit error from 60% to 1%; Underflow-Aware Probability Scaling prevents E4M3 scales from rounding long-context probabilities to zero; and Outlier-Aware Key Quantization combines static smoothing, Hadamard rotation, and scale search to suppress key outliers under token-wise scaling. At the system level, we remove the softmax bottleneck via transposed softmax with fused probability quantization and stacked query MMA on paged KV caches. Across dense and MoE models with GQA and MLA, BitDecoding-FP4 stays within 0.5 points of BF16 KV accuracy with NVFP4 (1 point with MXFP4), and tracks BF16 KV in RL training rollouts. In end-to-end serving on NVIDIA B300 with Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-30B-A3B, it delivers 2.4-3.0$\times$ higher peak serving throughput than BF16 KV. The implementation is available at https://github.com/OpenBitSys/BitDecoding-FP4.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 BitDecoding-FP4，用双残差查询量化、概率下溢感知缩放和离群感知 key 量化抑制精度损失，并配合转置 softmax 等系统优化，实现接近 BF16 精度的原生 FP4 KV cache 解码与 2.4–3.0 倍服务吞吐提升。
AI.relevance_reason: 其误差源分解（query 量化误差、长上下文概率下溢、key 离群）可供核查低比特 KV 缓存是否会削弱视觉证据与 latent 内容的保真度，但论文本身不涉及多模态推理或 latent 状态使用，借鉴性需进一步判断。
